price_definition: MT5 bid OHLC; spread, tick volume and real volume used nowhere
cost_basis: GROSS of cost -- statistical skill only, never a trading result
eligibility: H1: the as-of and target bars are consecutive hours and the as-of bar follows its predecessor by one hour (no bar bordering a market gap); D1: every row with a next bar. Zero moves are excluded from direction scoring.

direction.baselines: training-majority class and a 50 % coin, on the same rows
direction.verdict: CLEARED iff the two-sided (1 - alpha) paired moving-block bootstrap CI of mean(correct_model - correct_majority) AND of mean(correct_model - 0.5) both have lower bound > 0; else DROP. Pesaran-Timmermann reported alongside, not decisive.

return.verdict: CLEARED iff the one-sided Clark-West p-value < alpha; else DROP.

volatility.verdict: CLEARED iff the two-sided (1 - alpha) paired moving-block bootstrap CI of mean(|err_baseline| - |err_model|) has lower bound > 0; else DROP.

model_configs.gbm_tuning: inner purged walk-forward on the training block only; best mean inner ROC-AUC

garch.d1_garch: GARCH(1,1), constant mean, normal, fit on training returns only
garch.h1_garch_hod: GARCH(1,1), zero mean, on returns / training mean |r| per label hour; rescaled by the next hour

descriptive_only: accuracy by hour of day, flagged when > 1/2 of excess accuracy comes from the 00:00-06:00 labels (high-spread hours)
Deflated Sharpe of a gross sign strategy over the gold trial log

stages.test: after every validation verdict is committed: fit [0:80 %], score [80:100 %], once

direction.h1_gbm: possible CLEARED at 51-53 % (H_dir.1 GBM analogue: KEEP on EUR/USD 52.7 %, AUD/USD, CHF/USD; DROP on GBP/USD -- h1_direction_hypothesis_log.csv)
direction.h1_lstm: DROP more likely than CLEARED (H_dir.2: the EUR/USD H1 LSTM scored 51.6 % vs the GBM 52.7 %, DROP)

return.d1_gbm: DROP (Huber-loss shrinkage to the ~0 % conditional mean)
return.d1_lstm: DROP (Huber-loss shrinkage to the ~0 % conditional mean)
return.h1_gbm: DROP (Huber-loss shrinkage to the ~0 % conditional mean)
return.h1_lstm: DROP (Huber-loss shrinkage to the ~0 % conditional mean)
